# 4 benefits of getting a smartwatch for your kid


November 17, 2026


By Garmin team


### *Looking for a kid-friendly way to monitor and communicate with your child? Consider a kids smartwatch from Garmin.*


Kids are constantly on the move — whether it’s on the playground, at home or at practice. Encouraging kids to lead an active lifestyle and help around the house starts at an early age, and Garmin has just the smartwatch to make these activities fun.


A[Garmin smartwatch for kids](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/kids-wearables-fitness-activity-trackers/?currentPage=1) makes it easy to stay connected — helping you track your kiddo’s location1, communicate seamlessly and keep tabs on their activity and weekly chore list.


If you’re not sure a kids smartwatch makes sense for your child and need a little more convincing, here are a few benefits that parents love.


## 1. Location tracking


Kids are no strangers to exploring. Whether they’re bopping around friends’ houses or scooting through the neighborhood, we know staying up to date on your child’s whereabouts is important. Luckily, Garmin has a[kids smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/kids-wearables-fitness-activity-trackers/) for that.[Bounce™ 2](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1815501/pn/010-03399-02/) , the GPS-enabled watch for kids, provides real-time location tracking and allows parents to create parent-defined areas through the[Garmin Jr.™ app](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/568169/) with LTE connectivity. You’ll get notifications when your child enters or leaves the defined parameters. Plus, request notifications if your child leaves their current location.


Parents, feel at ease when[LiveTrack™ location](https://support.garmin.com/en-US/?faq=HbqxxbiBGA3mDhlLX4GUw8) sharing is activated. This assistance feature calls family contacts and sends a location sharing link to your child’s current location1.


## 2. Keep in touch


Bounce 2 includes a two-way calling and message system that helps you keep in touch with your child. Just ensure your Bounce 2 user has an[active plan](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/779781/pn/010-02000-SU/) and LTE connectivity2 and that you’ve downloaded the Garmin Jr. app.


Whether your child has updates on their whereabouts or wants to ask a quick question, they’ll be able to call and send voice messages from their kid-friendly watch through the built-in microphone and speaker. To pick up calls and answer messages, parents must have the Garmin Jr. app on a compatible mobile device. Parents can send text messages and call their child’s watch through the Garmin Jr. app and kids can respond from their wrist by using the full keyboard.


## 3. Activity & chore tracking


Maybe your child is into sports or you’re looking for a solution that makes weekly chores a bit more fun. If so, look no further. Bounce 2 lets kids track their steps, sleep and daily activity3 — whether running around the playground or swimming laps in the pool. Plus, they’ll earn rewards for doing so.


Looking for a way to make chores a little more enticing? Parents can manage and assign chores that kids can complete for additional rewards of your choosing.


## 4. Design and durability


Curious how well[Garmin kids watches](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/why-you-should-get-a-smartwatch-for-your-kids/) hold up? Well, they’re certainly durable. With a[swim-friendly](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/legal/waterrating-definitions/) design, kids can wear their watches while splashing around in the water. Bounce 2 users get up to 2 days of battery life4 and can choose between colors including slate grey, light purple and turquoise.


At Garmin, there’s a watch for every member of the family. Browse[Garmin smartwatches for kids](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/kids-wearables-fitness-activity-trackers/) and find one that’s perfect for your child.
